## Activity

During December 2024, Market Eye Clinic recorded 441 captures. This figure represents the site’s reported capture activity for the month. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes in the same reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 86 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 19.5. This result identifies the proportion of the month’s captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the overall activity total.

## Grading

Grading identified 106 referable results during December 2024. The median lag was 14. This records the central turnaround time for the grading process for the month. Together, the grading count and median lag provide a summary of the volume requiring referral and the time taken for results to progress through grading.

The figures above present the reported activity, image quality, and grading position for Market Eye Clinic for December 2024.
